description: ΘΕΣΕΙΣ ΕΛΕΓΧΟΜΕΝΗΣ ΣΤΑΘΜΕΥΣΗΣ is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by spatialdatadhmoskarditsas.nextgis.com. Punti ta' tgeżwir ikkontrollat. Coverage: GR. The portal shows the English title as "POZIȚII DE PARCARE CONTROLATE" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Τμήμα Γεωχωρικών Πληροφοριών, WEBGIS, κινητικότητα, Γεωχωρική πληροφορία. The listing shows 1 download or service links in JSON. The listing shows 2026-07-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution–NonCommercial 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
